parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "gpt-4o-mini",
  "max_tokens": 450,
  "temperature": 0.7,
  "messages": [{
    "role": "user",
    "content": "Write a short cover letter for Jerry.

Jerry is based in Taiwan and wants async global remote work.

Jerry's background:
- Bilingual English and Mandarin (grew up in California and Taiwan)
- Digital marketing background with data science bootcamp experience
- Technical: Python, SQL, Tableau, Power BI
- Marketing: Performance marketing, SEO, PPC, GA4, Meta Ads, Google Ads
- AI tools: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor
- Projects: dashboards, EDA, machine learning, customer segmentation, fraud detection, marketing analytics

Job being applied to:
Title: {{ $json.job_title }}
Company: {{ $json.company }}
Description: {{ $json.description.slice(0, 1500) }}

Focus on how Jerry can:
- Reduce manual analysis time
- Improve reporting speed
- Connect marketing and data
- Build AI-assisted workflows
- Turn messy data into business action

Keep it under 220 words.
Tone: confident, direct, human, not desperate.
Do not use a subject line. Start directly with the opening sentence."
  }]
}

meta.notes: SETUP REQUIRED: 1) Replace YOUR_SPREADSHEET_ID with your Google Sheet ID. 2) Configure Google Sheets OAuth2 credential. 3) Set OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable in n8n. 4) Configure Gmail OAuth2 credential. 5) Set YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID and configure Telegram Bot credential. 6) Create Google Sheet named 'Taiwan Eligible Async Remote Jobs' with 4 tabs: Raw Jobs, Filtered Jobs, Applied, Rejected. See README section below for column headers.

credentials_to_create: Google Sheets OAuth2 - for reading/writing job data
Gmail OAuth2 - for sending daily digest to 419vive@gmail.com
HTTP Header Auth - Name: Authorization, Value: Bearer YOUR_OPENAI_KEY (for cover letter node)
_setup_guide.one_sentence_rule: Every job must pass: I can do this job while living in Taiwan, without moving, without foreign work authorization, and without destroying my sleep schedule.
